title: Fukaya category with supports
summary: We associate to each compact subset $K$ of a closed symplectic manifold $M$ an $A_\infty$-category $\Fuk_K$, called the Fukaya category with support on $K$. The objects are tautologically unobstructed global Lagrangians endowed with appropriate decorations. The dependence on $K$ is detected by the morphism complexes which can be computed by completed telescopes associated with acceleration data for $K$.
